$description: How a PageSpec node may reference tokens. Enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py (TOKEN_* rules).

rawValueRestrictions.color: No raw hex / rgb() / rgba() / hsl() anywhere in a PageSpec; use a color.* token.
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: No raw px / rem / em / % lengths in token slots; use a space.* token.
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: Only font.family.* tokens; a font name string is rejected.

pairEvidence: Pairs observed in CLONE_SPEC.md sections 2-3 (measured computed colours): headline #FF5400 on #FAE3E2, footer #FDF8F5 on #FF5400, pill text #F9E2E1 on #000 and on #FF5400, CTA #FDF8F5 on #000, testimonial #FF5400 on #FDF8F5, FAQ #333 on #F2E3DA, menu links on rgba(249,226,225,.95).
overrides: PageSpec nodes may only select tokens through the slots above; there is no free-form style field.
